assignment: Watch one episode with Japanese subtitles. Note three words you hear twice.

assignment: Write down one sentence you can follow.

assignment: Watch one scene and write down every katakana word you see.

assignment: Set the language to Japanese kana. Play for 20 minutes.

assignment: Shadow one section of it, even if slowly.

assignment: Short kana-only text and repeated phrases. Note down each command.

assignment: Kana-only and everyday language. Read every town sign.

title: Haru yo, Koi
assignment: Find five words you know in the lyrics.

assignment: Read the title and lyric sheet once, then listen and follow.

title: Tampopo
assignment: Watch the food scenes and write down what's ordered.

title: Shall We Dance?
assignment: Listen for polite workplace language.

title: Bocchi the Rock!
assignment: Fast speech in places. Replay one scene until you catch three phrases.

title: Frieren: Beyond Journey's End
assignment: Slow, clear speech. Note every sentence ending you recognise.

title: Tokyo Story
assignment: Polite, measured family speech. Note how the characters use polite forms.

title: Plastic Love

assignment: Read the lyric sheet, and note what you can read unaided.

title: Monster
assignment: Watch with Japanese subtitles if you can find them. Note school-related words.

title: Drive My Car
japanese title: ドライブ・マイ・カー
